clauses.mechanism: own_terms_outer_limit (exemption for such time as may be deemed necessary, but not beyond the close of business November 30, 1947)
clauses.reason: whole: The order further exempts George T. Summerlin from compulsory retirement for age "but not beyond the close of business November 30, 1947". The exemption therefore could not run past that date, and no held source shows an earlier end; the first end is recorded as 1947-11-30, inclusive (the exclusive reading is that the exemption lapsed as that day began). The phrase 'for such time as may be deemed necessary' would permit an earlier end by determination, but no such determination is held, so the outer limit is the best supported date. The order is a single time-limited exemption with no continuing duty after the limit.

research_rationale:
EO 9271 (November 17, 1942), read in full in the American Presidency Project transcription registered for this order (jobs/app-executive-orders/output/texts, grade mirror_transcription, acceptable_as_original false; standing note: original not yet held; replace and re-check quotes when an official copy is retrieved). The APP page check (AGENT_PROTOCOL.md working-text paragraph) in the packet LOOKUPS.md records a mirror page (Common Crawl capture) whose heading names Executive Order 9271, whose date 1942-11-17 agrees with the held text and whose text_sha256 equals the held file's. Clauses are quoted from that registered file, not from the clause-drafts copy. The order further exempts George T. Summerlin, a Foreign Service Officer of Class I, from compulsory retirement for age under section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932 (47 Stat. 382, 404) for such time as may be deemed necessary, but not beyond the close of business November 30, 1947. It follows EO 7726 of October 12, 1937, which exempted him for five years. The order has no other term. The exemption cannot run past its stated limit, so it ended by its own terms no later than the close of business on 1947-11-30, recorded inclusive (the exclusive reading is that it ends when November 30, 1947 begins, i.e. 1947-11-29 at close of business). AI producer hypothesis only; not human certification.
